goal: The client record (#customer/<phone>) carries six operator-owned properties whose provenance is visible and whose human-written values the agent can never overwrite: حقيقة (human) / قراءة (agent) / ناقص (absent). Contract: .orbit/artifacts/crm-record/requirements.md; plan: .orbit/artifacts/crm-record/plan.md.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /admin/customer/<phone> returns contact.props containing only the six keys (decisionMaker, orgProfile, productInterest, nextStep, note, disqualifyReason); a seventh key in a write is rejected with 400 {ok:false, error:'unknown_property', key} and no partial write of the other keys.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: curl transcript against a locally booted engine, no WhatsApp send

acceptance_criteria.text: BR-1/BR-7: after a human write of decisionMaker, an agent inference of a different value leaves value, source:'human', by and ts unchanged; contested is populated; exactly one prop_rejected:<key> event is logged. FAIL if the value changed.
BR-7b: an agent-sourced write to note or orgProfile returns {applied:false, reason:'not_agent_writable'} and stores nothing (no value, no contested).
FR-7: confirming a reading (أكّد) sets source:'human' and populates prior with the agent value/by/ts; correcting (صحّح) stores the rejected reading in prior.

Upsert trap: after a props write, firing an inbound event and a status event and then restart-hydrating leaves all six props identical. props appears nowhere in upsertContact's INSERT column list or ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE clause.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: check:props behaviour + structural grep of the upsertContact SQL body

acceptance_criteria.text: BR-4: the props route body contains no gupshup.* or agent.* call, and a send-spy (gupshup.send* stubbed to throw) records zero outbound calls for a full six-key write and for a rejected agent write.

BR-2: a human correction of productInterest rewrites interest_tags AND writes props.productInterest with source:'human' in ONE committed transaction; unchanged products keep their original ts; the chip renders حقيقة.

NFR-3: with DATABASE_URL unset or the DB unreachable, a human property write returns 503 {ok:false, persisted:false}, memory is NOT mutated, the UI shows «لم يُحفظ — أعد المحاولة», and editors render disabled when propsWritable is false. Nothing claims success.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: curl with DATABASE_URL unset + screenshot of the disabled state

acceptance_criteria.text: RTL: the facts panel renders dir=rtl; labels lead right; phone and date run LTR-isolated with no bracket flipping; Arabic-Indic numerals pass check:numerals; no horizontal scroll at 390px and 1440px.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: screenshots at both widths + check:numerals output

acceptance_criteria.text: BR-3: a human disqualifyReason sets contact.outcome and outcomeReason; opted_out stays false.
NFR-1: a 121-char short text returns 400 {error:'too_long', key, max} with no write; an empty/whitespace value removes the key and the field renders «ناقص»; no empty string is ever stored.
BR-5: each accepted write appears exactly once in the timeline as prop:<key>, naming the key and the writer.
Discovery §3: a contact with all six properties missing shows six visible «ناقص» holes, each tappable, replacing the unrendered contextScore as the what-we-are-missing indicator.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: screenshot of a bare contact record

acceptance_criteria.text: Single-door (plan §4): no module other than src/tracker.ts writes props — no `.props =` assignment and no upsertProps( call outside tracker.ts; every named call site in agent.ts and index.ts goes through writeProp. check:props is wired into npm run check and fails the build (non-zero exit) when violated, and reports [inert] if dist/tracker.js exports no writeProp.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: npm run check output + the gate source

acceptance_criteria.text: ADR-0001 compliance and no blank render: dashboard.ts edits are anchored replacements only, the function-definition count delta equals the number of new helpers, vCustomer is not rewritten wholesale, no backtick appears in the file, and npm run smoke exits 0 after deploy.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: grep -c '^function \|^  function ' src/dashboard.ts before/after + npm run smoke output + the diff

acceptance_criteria.text: Safety: npm run build exits 0 (strict TS); GET https://massar-engine.fly.dev/health returns ok:true and outbound.ok:true after deploy; zero WhatsApp messages were sent to any number during the increment; webhook token auth and the «إيقاف»/STOP path are intact.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: build log, health JSON, and the absence of any send in the diff and logs
